title: 夏日归来
en: A wide establishing shot of a small coastal railway station in Japan on the last clear morning of August. A cream and pale-blue local train has just stopped beside a weathered wooden shelter. A 22-year-old Japanese woman with a chin-length straight black bob, wispy fringe and a small mole below her left eye steps onto the platform, wearing an ivory short-sleeved cotton blouse, a calf-length navy skirt, brown loafers and a faded canvas shoulder bag. She is small in the right third of the frame. Beyond the left end of the platform, the sea glitters between telephone poles and wind-bent pines. The camera looks down the tracks at platform height, with an out-of-focus hydrangea leaf in the near foreground. Hard summer sunlight, pale concrete, faded greens and a slight heat haze; an observational 35mm live-action film frame, without captions or graphic overlays.

title: 熟悉的街道
en: A narrow downhill lane in a Japanese seaside town, framed by timber houses, rusty rain gutters and a low stone wall covered in trailing plants. A 22-year-old Japanese woman with a chin-length black bob, wispy fringe and a mole beneath her left eye walks a pale-blue step-through bicycle downhill. She wears an ivory short-sleeved cotton blouse, calf-length navy skirt, brown loafers and a faded canvas shoulder bag. The front wheel is turned slightly as she pauses to let a breeze pass. A slice of turquoise sea appears at the far end of the lane. The camera is inside the shaded doorway of a house, looking outward past the dark doorframe; the woman is in profile, moving into a patch of sun. Dappled leaf shadows, faded blue paint, textured plaster and the quiet brightness of analog summer cinema.

title: 意外重逢
en: At a quiet railway crossing above the sea, two young Japanese adults recognize each other from opposite sides of the tracks. On the near left stands a 22-year-old woman with a chin-length black bob, wispy fringe and a small mole below her left eye, an ivory cotton blouse, navy calf-length skirt and canvas shoulder bag, holding a pale-blue bicycle upright. Across the tracks on the right is a 23-year-old man with short slightly wavy black hair, a pale blue open-collar linen shirt, charcoal trousers and white canvas sneakers. Both have stopped walking; their eyes meet without a theatrical smile. The rails draw two diagonal lines through the space between them. The crossing is empty and safe, with the barriers raised and no train visible. An eye-level wide shot from several meters away, sunlit gravel, distant sea and gentle midday haze, understated natural expressions.

title: 空无一人的教室
en: An empty former school classroom in a small Japanese coastal town, photographed from the open back door. Rows of worn wooden desks face an unmarked dark green chalkboard. On the windowsill a forgotten translucent glass marble catches the sun, casting a tiny blue-green patch of refracted light onto the wood. White cotton curtains billow inward through open windows, revealing green treetops and a narrow strip of sea beyond. The nearest desk is softly out of focus, while the far windows and their rectangular pools of sunlight organize the composition. Late-morning light is bright but not nostalgic sepia; scratches, chipped varnish and slightly uneven floors make the room feel lived in. A quiet observational widescreen still with no people, no readable writing and no decorative graphics.

title: 没说出口的话
en: Inside a modest seaside cafe with faded mint-green walls, two young Japanese adults sit across a small wooden table by the window. The 22-year-old woman has a chin-length black bob, wispy fringe, a small mole under her left eye, an ivory cotton blouse and navy skirt; the 23-year-old man has short slightly wavy black hair and a pale blue linen shirt with charcoal trousers. Two separate tall glasses of pale melon soda stand between them, beads of condensation gathering around the bases. He looks toward the woman while she watches a melting ice cube in her glass, one hand resting against the tumbler. Their shoulders are relaxed, the silence visible in the unoccupied space between their faces. A lateral medium two-shot from the neighboring booth, soft daylight crossing the table, warm shadows under the seats, authentic worn surfaces and subtle film grain.

title: 指尖的距离
en: A close insert shot of the same cafe table, photographed at table height with an intimate shallow depth of field. On the left, a young woman's relaxed right hand emerges from the short sleeve of an ivory cotton blouse, palm resting naturally on the worn wooden tabletop. On the right, a young man's left hand emerges beside the cuff of a pale blue linen shirt. Their fingertips stop a few centimeters apart without touching. Both hands are anatomically natural, with five fingers each and no jewelry. Behind them, two partly finished glasses of melon soda blur into soft green shapes, while condensation forms a small irregular wet ring on the wood. A narrow stripe of afternoon sunlight falls across the gap between their fingers. The frame contains only hands, forearms, table and glasses; no faces, no writing. A restrained tactile detail from a live-action romance.

title: 突如其来的雨
en: A sudden summer rainstorm washes over a quiet Japanese coastal road. Under a small corrugated-roof bus shelter stand two young adults: a 22-year-old Japanese woman with a chin-length black bob, wispy fringe and ivory cotton blouse with navy skirt, and a 23-year-old Japanese man with short slightly wavy black hair, a pale blue linen shirt and charcoal trousers. Her faded canvas bag is tucked against her body; he moves a little to the side so the roof covers her. A pale-blue bicycle waits just beyond the shelter, its saddle darkened by rain. The camera looks across the road through a soft curtain of falling water, with silver puddle reflections in the foreground and wet hydrangeas on the right. Cool gray daylight, a little warm reflected color from the shelter's wood, wet hair and realistic fine droplets. A medium-wide shot, neither character looking at camera.

title: 玻璃另一侧
en: Inside a nearly empty coastal commuter train shortly after the rain, a 22-year-old Japanese woman with a chin-length straight black bob, wispy fringe and a small mole below her left eye sits alone beside a window, wearing an ivory short-sleeved cotton blouse and calf-length navy skirt. Her faded canvas bag rests on her lap. She turns her face toward the passing sea, chin lightly supported by her hand. A faint reflection of her face appears on the rain-speckled glass, superimposed over wet green fields and a distant silver-blue ocean. The reflection is dimmer than her actual face and obeys the angle of the window. The camera observes her from across the aisle behind a neighboring seat, which softly masks the lower left edge. Diffuse overcast light, dark green upholstery, muted blue-green tones and an unhurried widescreen 35mm film composition.

title: 最后一场烟火
en: From a grassy embankment overlooking a small Japanese harbor at night, two young adults watch the last fireworks of summer. The 22-year-old woman with a chin-length black bob wears an ivory short-sleeved cotton blouse and navy skirt; the 23-year-old man with slightly wavy short black hair wears a pale blue linen shirt and charcoal trousers. They sit side by side facing the water, viewed from behind, their shoulders separated by a narrow gap. One modest golden firework unfolds high above distant fishing boats, with its fragmented reflections scattered across rippling harbor water. A few amber festival lanterns glow far down the waterfront, not close to the couple. The figures are nearly silhouetted, with thin warm highlights on their hair and shoulders. Wide static composition from low behind the grass, a dark indigo sky, restrained exposure and a feeling of a fleeting ordinary evening.

title: 分别之前
en: A small coastal railway platform in Japan at blue hour on the following morning, before the first train arrives. At the left edge, a 22-year-old Japanese woman with a chin-length black bob, wispy fringe, ivory cotton blouse, calf-length navy skirt and canvas shoulder bag stands beside a small navy rolling suitcase. Several meters to her right, a 23-year-old Japanese man with short slightly wavy black hair, pale blue linen shirt and charcoal trousers stands with his arms loosely at his sides. They face each other, neither moving closer. The empty concrete platform and a softly glowing shelter lamp occupy the broad middle of the frame. Beyond the tracks, a calm ocean reflects the first faint line of dawn. Static eye-level long shot, horizontal architectural lines, restrained cool blue tones with one warm practical light, believable human proportions and no exaggerated gestures.

title: 开往远方的列车
en: An elevated wide view from a coastal hillside in Japan as a small cream and pale-blue commuter train travels away along a curving single railway track beside the sea. The rear of the train is visible in the middle distance, moving toward the left where the track vanishes behind a green headland. On the far right, a modest station platform remains almost empty; a tiny solitary young man in a pale blue shirt stands still beneath the wooden shelter. The sun has just risen, illuminating the sea in soft silver and gold, while the nearest slope stays cool and green. Wild grasses sway in the lower foreground. The camera is stationary, with generous space around the train, no dramatic motion blur, coherent railway perspective and the gentle grain of a live-action feature film. No titles or subtitles.

title: 夏天结束了
en: The final empty frame of a Japanese coastal coming-of-age film: a pale-blue step-through bicycle stands on its kickstand beside a low weathered stone wall overlooking the ocean. Its basket is empty, the metal bell catches a pinpoint of morning light and a few drops of yesterday's rain remain on the saddle. The narrow road curves gently away behind sunlit grass; distant fishing boats appear as tiny dark marks on the calm sea. A soft breeze bends the grasses and lifts one dry leaf near the front wheel. The camera is placed at the height of the wall, with the bicycle on the left third and a broad expanse of sea and pale sky to the right. Early golden light, salt-weathered textures, subtle cool shadows and an understated sense of absence. No people, no text, no watermark or graphic overlays.
